name: Piwigo
description: Piwigo is a photo gallery software for the web that comes with powerful features to publish and manage your collection of pictures.

questions.label: Web port
questions.hint: The port on this server that opens the app.

questions.label: Mysql root password
questions.hint: Generated automatically. Enter your own to replace it.

questions.label: Mysql password
questions.hint: Generated automatically. Enter your own to replace it.

compose:
# Service definitions for the big-bear-piwigo application
services:
  # Service name: big-bear-piwigo
  # The `big-bear-piwigo` service definition
  big-bear-piwigo:
    # Name of the container
    container_name: big-bear-piwigo
    # Image to be used for the container
    image: linuxserver/piwigo:16.4.0@sha256:ae48cf752e94920c06c49cbfd902266e3a7822c90c418b6090137509637b1106
    # Container restart policy
    restart: unless-stopped
    # Environment variables
    environment:
      - PUID=1000 # User ID for the container
      - PGID=1000 # Group ID for the container
      - TZ=UTC # Timezone setting for the container
    # Volumes to be mounted to the container
    volumes:
      - ${APP_DATA_DIR}/config:/config # Configuration files
      - ${APP_DATA_DIR}/gallery:/gallery # Gallery files
    # Ports mapping between host and container
    ports:
      - "${APP_PORT}:80" # Mapping port 8080 of the host to port 80 of the container
    networks:
      - big_bear_piwigo_network
  big-bear-piwigo-db:
    image: mariadb:10.6@sha256:114d40be36852d0a019afd8458f7e1cc63fd300403b115b1f32e31130d5f671b
    container_name: big-bear-piwigo-db
    environment:
      - MYSQL_ROOT_PASSWORD=${SECRET_MYSQL_ROOT_PASSWORD} # Root password for MySQL
      - MYSQL_DATABASE=piwigo # Database name
      - MYSQL_USER=big_bear_piwigo # Database user
      - MYSQL_PASSWORD=${SECRET_MYSQL_PASSWORD} # Database user password
    volumes:
      - ${APP_DATA_DIR}/mysql:/var/lib/mysql # Persist database data
    restart: unless-stopped
    networks:
      - big_bear_piwigo_network
# Network definition for the big-bear-piwigo application
networks:
  big_bear_piwigo_network:
    driver: bridge # Defines the network driver to be used (bridge)
